knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,	message = FALSE,	warning = FALSE,	comment = "",	crop = TRUE )
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=10) 

options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)

# Reset lists
rm(list=ls())

# Libraries
library(rmarkdown)                   # note: requires knitr 1.21

require(tidyverse, quietly=TRUE)     # combined package of dplyr, tidyr, ggplot, readr, purrr and tibble
require(lubridate, quietly=TRUE)     # data handling
require(reshape2, quietly=TRUE)      # reshaping data; e.g. cast
require(RColorBrewer)                # colour schemes
library(viridis)
library(pander)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)                   # composer of plots

library(captioner)                   # for captions
tab_nums <- captioner::captioner(prefix = "Table " , levels=1, type=c("n"), infix=".")
fig_nums <- captioner::captioner(prefix = "Figure ", levels=1, type=c("n"), infix=".")

# Source all the utils
source("../../flyshoot/R/FLYSHOOT utils.r")

datadir   <- "C:/Users/MartinPastoors/Martin Pastoors/WQ - General/2025/data"
rdatadir   <- "C:/Users/MartinPastoors/Martin Pastoors/WQ - General/2025/rdata"
spatialdir <- "C:/DATA/RDATA"
gisdir     <- "C:/DATA/GIS"

rect_lr_sf  <- loadRData(file.path(spatialdir, "rect_lr_sf.RData")) %>% rename(rect=ICESNAME)
world_mr_sf <- loadRData(file.path(spatialdir, "world_mr_sf.RData")) %>% sf::st_as_sf()
eez_sf      <- 
  loadRData(file.path(spatialdir, "eez_sf.RData")) %>% 
  # sf::st_simplify(., preserveTopology = FALSE, dTolerance = 500) %>% 
  rename(country = ISO_SOV1) %>% 
  filter(country %in% c("DEU","DNK","GBR","NLD","BEL","FRA")) %>% 
  mutate(class="eez")

asfis       <- loadRData(file.path(spatialdir, "asfis.RData"))

# janitor::compare_df_cols(e1, m) %>% View()

e <-
  bind_rows(
    loadRData("C:/Users/MartinPastoors/Martin Pastoors/FLYSHOOT - General/rdata/elog.RData") %>% 
      dplyr::select(vessel, year, month, date, species, rect, weight=liveweight), 
    ) %>% 
  left_join(rect_lr_sf, by="rect") %>% 
  sf::st_as_sf()

# load("C:/Users/MartinPastoors/Martin Pastoors/WQ - General/2024/rdata/weforsea.RData")
  
# calculate the scaling of plots
bb <- sf::st_bbox(e)
xmin <- bb[1]
xmax <- bb[3] ;
ymin <- bb[2]
ymax <- bb[4]
xlim <- c(xmin, xmax); ylim <- c(ymin, ymax)

\newpage

Overview of mackerel landings per rect and per month  

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.asp=1.0, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

fig_nums(
  name    = "map1", 
  level = 1, display = FALSE,
  caption = "Landings (kg) of participating vessels in 'open' parts of the EEZs (black), MPAs (red) and offshore wind areas (blue). ")

e %>% 
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(date)) %>% 
  filter(year >= 2023, year <= 2024, species=="MAC") %>% 
  group_by(species, year, month, rect) %>% 
  summarise(
    weight = sum(weight, na.rm=TRUE),
    ndays  = n_distinct(vessel, date)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(weightperday = weight / ndays) %>% 
  # mutate(., weightperday_interval = cut(weightperday, 
  #           scales::trans_breaks("sqrt", function(x) x ^ 2)(c(0, max(weightperday, na.rm=TRUE))), 
  #                                dig.lab=10 ) ) %>% 
  mutate(., weightperday_interval = cut(weightperday, 
            breaks=c(0,20,50,100,1000,10000), 
                                 dig.lab=10 ) ) %>% 

  sf::st_as_sf() %>% 
  
  # filter(is.na(weightperday_interval)) %>% View()

  
  ggplot() +
  theme_publication() +
  # theme(legend.position = "none") +
  
  geom_sf(data=rect_lr_sf, fill=NA, colour="lightgray") +
  geom_sf(data=world_mr_sf) +
  geom_sf(data=eez_sf, linetype="dashed", fill=NA) +
  
  # catches
  geom_sf(aes(fill=weightperday_interval), alpha=0.8) +
  
  coord_sf(xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim)  +
  labs(fill="weight/day/vessel (kg)", title="Mackerel landings 2023-2024 per day and per vessel of selected vessels") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~month, ncol=4)


```

_`r fig_nums("map1")`_
